baseline-discipline.why: Every task needs load-bearing invariants, curated context, and change governance.

verification-gate.why: Define done before work and verify with observed evidence (M0.3).

resumable-memory.why: Work that spans a session must externalize state and resume from it.

traceable-sources.why: Cited material demands every claim trace to a primary source (M0.1).

self-improving-loop.why: Multi-session work benefits from an explicit signal→audit→mutation→journal loop (M0.10).

tool-use.why: A task that touches the world needs a minimal, progressive toolset.

human-review-gate.why: Others are involved or stakes are high: escalate irreversible decisions (M0.8).

high-stakes-guardrails.why: When stakes are high, strengthen gates and lower autonomy.

reproducible-experiments.why: Data/research with measurable outcomes must be reproducible and traceable.

long-horizon-autonomy-control.why: A long, high-stakes run needs durable memory, hard gates, and low autonomy.

frontier-standard.why: Measure output against the best-known standard, ratchet up monotonically, and track the moving frontier (M0.3/M0.5/M0.10); never self-declare excellence.

sandboxed-execution.title_zh: 沙箱 / 最小权限执行
sandboxed-execution.why: Anything that executes code or reaches the world declares an execution backend and a least-privilege posture (isolation, approval for irreversible acts) rather than running unconstrained (M0.4/M0.8).

portable-skills.title_zh: 可移植技能（Agent Skills 格式）
portable-skills.why: Skills are emitted in the Agent Skills (SKILL.md) open format so the same skill loads in any compatible harness (agentskills.io), not just the one that generated it.
